    10	
    11	A submodule with projective quotient base-changes without a flatness hypothesis.
    12	After choosing an equivalence from the base-changed ambient module to a concrete

    35	  (projectiveQuotientBaseChangeEquiv (S := S) N).trans

    45	    ((projectiveQuotientFibreModelEquiv N e W hW x : W) : V) =

    36	The statement is proved here rather than imported from a geometry-specific
    37	module so that the image-conjugacy theorem below remains inexpensive to use.

    39	theorem range_baseChange_linear (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    40	    LinearMap.range (LinearMap.baseChange S f) =
    41	      Submodule.baseChange S (LinearMap.range f) := by
    42	  apply le_antisymm
    43	  · rw [LinearMap.range_le_iff_comap, eq_top_iff]
    44	    rintro z -
    45	    induction z with
    46	    | zero => simp
    47	    | tmul a m =>
    48	        rw [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
    49	        exact Submodule.tmul_mem_baseChange_of_mem a
    50	          (LinearMap.mem_range_self f m)
    51	    | add x y hx hy =>
    52	        rw [Submodule.mem_comap, map_add]
    53	        exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.mem_comap.1 hx)
    54	          (Submodule.mem_comap.1 hy)
    55	  · rw [Submodule.baseChange_eq_span, Submodule.span_le]
    56	    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    57	    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hy
    58	    exact ⟨(1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] m, by
    59	      rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, TensorProduct.mk_apply]⟩

    61	/-! ## Transport through a conjugacy square -/
    62	
    63	/-- The image of `f` after scalar extension, transported through equivalences
    64	on source and target, is exactly the image of the conjugate map `f'`.
    65	
    66	The hypothesis is pointwise so callers can discharge it with the naturality
    67	lemma for their chosen fibre equivalences. -/
    68	theorem map_baseChange_range_eq_range_of_conjugate
    69	    (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    70	    {M' N' : Type u} [AddCommGroup M'] [Module S M']
    71	      [AddCommGroup N'] [Module S N']
    72	    (f' : M' →ₗ[S] N')
    73	    (eM : (S ⊗[R] M) ≃ₗ[S] M')
    74	    (eN : (S ⊗[R] N) ≃ₗ[S] N')
    75	    (hconj : ∀ x : S ⊗[R] M,
    76	      eN (LinearMap.baseChange S f x) = f' (eM x)) :
    77	    Submodule.map eN.toLinearMap
    78	        (Submodule.baseChange S (LinearMap.range f)) =
    79	      LinearMap.range f' := by
    80	  rw [← range_baseChange_linear (S := S) f]
    81	  apply le_antisymm
    82	  · rintro z ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    83	    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hy
    84	    change eN (LinearMap.baseChange S f x) ∈ LinearMap.range f'
    85	    rw [hconj]
    86	    exact LinearMap.mem_range_self f' (eM x)
    87	  · rintro z ⟨x, rfl⟩
    88	    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := eM.surjective x
    89	    refine ⟨LinearMap.baseChange S f y, ?_, hconj y⟩
    90	    exact LinearMap.mem_range_self (LinearMap.baseChange S f) y
